summary: Off The Hook YS Inc. (the Company) filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its acquisition of Apex Marine, LLC, Apex Marine Sales, LLC, and Apex Marine Stuart, LLC (collectively Apex) on May 13, 2026, per a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement dated February 13, 2026. The aggregate purchase price was $5,966,667, consisting of $1.2 million cash, 679,012 shares valued at $2.70/share ($1,800,000), and two promissory notes: one for $2,466,667 (secured by the purchased interests, 6% interest, 24 monthly payments) and one for $500,000 (due in 365 days, no interest except default). The seller was Ismael Pereira, with no prior relationship. Financial statements will be filed within 60 days. Watch for integration execution and note repayment performance.
